title: The Murim Abolitionist
subtitle: The Blacksmith Who Closes Wounds
author: Nitty Gritty Novel Lab
description: When a duel between two martial masters destroys his family and village, blacksmith Jin Cheol chooses a target larger than revenge: the lawless order of murim itself. After learning that every dantian begins as a wound in the soul, he takes up the hammer—and the very cultivation he despises—to build a world where power can finally be laid down.
